rows.evidence: End to end, three [ac:] tests. (1) Indexer: src/server/services/pages-link-indexer.test.ts:224 asserts resolve source→builtin→map order (rootId 'c' / 'pages' / 'b' / null→'pages') and autocomplete spanning all roots with the duplicated x.md offered once from the precedence winner. (2) Route (uncommitted): src/server/routes/page-links.route.test.ts asserts GET /autocomplete?q=x&root=b → x.md exactly once with {rootId:'b', title:'X in b'}, and without ?root= → paths ['only-b.md','x.md'] with x.md from builtin 'pages' although 'a','b' come first in the map. The route reads ?root= and passes it (src/server/routes/page-links.ts:34-37 → indexer.autocomplete(q, limit, root), pages-link-indexer.ts:460-476 via resolutionOrder :320-330). (3) Client (uncommitted): src/client/tiptap/mentionFiles.root.test.ts asserts the page editor's mention_extension gets options.rootId 'a' from RegistryContext.rootId (registrations.ts:191-196), the '@' files source sends root=a on /page-links/autocomplete (registrations.ts:220-225 → api.ts autocomplete sets 'root') and the popup offers {rootId:'a', title:'X in a'}; in a plan no root is sent and the builtin entry is offered. Real path: Editor.tsx:89 passes rootId into the page ctx; MentionExtension hands {rootId} to source.search via mentionItems; PageRefPopover also passes the chip's root (editor.storage.pageRefRootId, Editor.tsx:192). Plan/brief/patch/chat editors pass no rootId → builtin first, matching resolve(…, null). Tests are consistent with the current code; typecheck clean.
